description: Source code for a caching module in a network link management library, including functions for cache creation, deletion, modification, synchronization, and parsing of netlink messages.

methods.name: nl_cache_alloc
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new cache with specified operations.

methods.name: nl_cache_alloc_and_fill
methods.description: Allocates a cache and fills it with data from the kernel via refill.

methods.name: nl_cache_clear
methods.description: Removes all elements from a cache.

methods.name: nl_cache_free
methods.description: Frees a cache and its elements.

methods.name: nl_cache_add
methods.description: Adds an object to a cache, cloning if necessary.

methods.name: nl_cache_remove
methods.description: Removes an object from its cache.

methods.name: nl_cache_request_full_dump
methods.description: Requests a full dump of cache data from the kernel.

methods.name: nl_cache_parse
methods.description: Parses a netlink message and adds it to the cache.

methods.name: nl_cache_parse_and_add
methods.description: Parses a netlink message and adds the resulting object to the cache.

methods.name: nl_cache_refill
methods.description: Refills a cache with current kernel data.

methods.name: nl_cache_pickup
methods.description: Receives and parses netlink messages into a cache.
